LUKE’S TRAVEL BLOG
Sunday, August 25th
Bad experiences
My trip’s been full of surprises so far. First, my flight here was delayed.
| took the next one, and | was upgraded to first class! Then | discovered
that my visa was expired, but | was issued one at the airport on arrival.
| arte
Good thing! But they lost my luggage.
When | went to my two-star hotel, | found out it was overbooked. But |
had a reservation, and it was guaranteed. So, they put me in a four-star
hotel for the same price.
| read that the museums here are always packed and the restaurants are
overrated and overpriced. But | went to a museum early this morning,
and there were only a few people there. | even got a discounted ticket!
After that, | went to a famous restaurant for lunch. It was priced right,
and it was the best meal I’ve ever had.
B What experiences have you had like Luke’s? Which have you never had?
